proposals.evidence: Turner explicitly gives Gujarati ākhũ whole and Marathi akhā/ākhā whole, undivided under akṣata unhurt/unbroken. The Mewari and Noiri survey adjectives match this contracted kh-bearing western family, with inflectional endings; l-expanded whole forms remain excluded because they raise an additional akhila comparison.
